title: Research and publications
introduction: My professional projects regularly involve scientific research activities. Passionate and, above all, incredibly curious, I have had the opportunity to explore a variety of research fields: experimental biophysics, numerical simulations, molecular communication engineering, the development of artificial intelligence models, and even inclusive education. On this page, you will find all these research themes and the scientific publications that resulted from them.
